Title: Get all employees successfully
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe returns a list of all employees
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe
Receive response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains a list of employees

Title: Get employee by valid id
Description: Verify that the API returns employee details when a valid id is provided
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with valid employee id
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with employee details in response body

Title: Get employee by non-existing id
Description: Verify that the API returns 404 when employee with given id does not exist
Pre-Conditions: No employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with non-existing employee id
Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found with message 'employee not found'

Title: Get employee with null id
Description: Verify that the API returns 400 when id path parameter is null
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with null id
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'id is required'

Title: Create employee with valid name and role
Description: Verify that creating an employee with valid name and role succeeds
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with valid name and role in body
Expected Result: Response status 201 Created with employee object in response body and Location header set

Title: Create employee with missing name
Description: Verify that creating an employee without name returns bad request
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with role only in body
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with missing role
Description: Verify that creating an employee without role returns bad request
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with name only in body
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with empty name
Description: Verify that creating an employee with empty name returns bad request
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with empty name and valid role in body
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with empty role
Description: Verify that creating an employee with empty role returns bad request
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with valid name and empty role in body
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with null body
Description: Verify that creating an employee with null request body returns bad request
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with null body
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Update employee with valid id and valid body
Description: Verify updating an existing employee with valid id and valid request body updates the employee and returns 200
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Include valid JSON body with fields to update
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains updated employee with new values

Title: Update employee with null id
Description: Verify updating employee with null id returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with body {"message":"id is required"}

Title: Update employee with null request body
Description: Verify updating employee with null request body returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Do not include request body or send null body
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with body {"message":"request body is required"}

Title: Update employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify updating employee with id that does not exist returns 404 with error message
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with given id
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
Include valid request body
Expected Result: Response status is 404 Not Found with body {"message":"employee not found"}

Title: Update employee with partial fields in request body
Description: Verify updating employee with partial fields updates only those fields and returns 200
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Include request body with only some fields (e.g. only name)
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains employee with updated name and other fields unchanged

Title: Delete employee with valid id
Description: Verify deleting an existing employee by valid id returns 204 No Content
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with valid existing id
Expected Result: Response status is 204 No Content and employee is deleted

Title: Delete employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with non-existing id returns 404 employee not found
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
Expected Result: Response status is 404 with body {"message":"employee not found"}

Title: Delete employee with null id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with null id returns 400 id is required
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
Expected Result: Response status is 400 with body {"message":"id is required"}

Title: Get diff with no parameters
Description: Verify GET /diff returns diff report with default parameters
Test Steps: Send GET request to /diff without any query parameters
Observe the response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains diff report JSON array

Title: Get diff with unsupported query parameter
Description: Verify GET /diff returns error or ignores unsupported query parameters
Test Steps: Send GET request to /diff with unsupported query parameter ?invalid=param
Observe the response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains diff report JSON array ignoring unsupported parameters

Title: Get diff with large data set
Description: Verify GET /diff returns correct diff report when large data set exists
Pre-Conditions: API server is running and large test data sets are present
Test Steps: Send GET request to /diff
Observe the response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains complete diff report JSON array with all changes

Title: POST /run with valid body
Description: Verify POST /run returns success with valid request body
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with valid JSON body
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains success indication

Title: POST /run with empty body
Description: Verify POST /run returns error when request body is empty
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with empty body
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request and error message is returned

Title: POST /run with invalid JSON body
Description: Verify POST /run returns error when request body is invalid JSON
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with invalid JSON body
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request and error message is returned

Title: POST /run with missing required fields
Description: Verify POST /run returns error when required fields are missing in request body
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with JSON body missing required fields
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request and error message is returned

Title: POST /run with extra fields in body
Description: Verify POST /run ignores extra fields in request body and returns success
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with valid JSON body including extra fields
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains success indication

Title: POST /run with large payload
Description: Verify POST /run handles large request body without error
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with large JSON body
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains success indication

Title: POST /run with invalid content type
Description: Verify POST /run returns error when Content-Type header is invalid
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with valid JSON body and invalid Content-Type header
Expected Result: Response status is 415 Unsupported Media Type and error message is returned

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
Description: Send a valid list of attendance records to mark batch attendance
Test Steps: Prepare a list of attendance DTOs with valid employeeId, absent, and optional date
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify response contains savedRecords list with attendance records
Verify presentCount and absentCount are correct
Verify invalidEntries list is empty

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Send an empty list to mark batch attendance
Test Steps: Prepare an empty list
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty list as body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
Description: Send null as payload to mark batch attendance
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
Description: Send a list with some attendance DTOs missing required fields
Test Steps: Prepare a list of attendance DTOs where some have null employeeId or absent
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify invalidEntries list contains employeeIds of invalid entries
Verify presentCount and absentCount are correct

Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent true
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent set to true
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId and absent true
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance record with absent true
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance record showing absent true

Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent false
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent set to false
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId and absent false
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance record with absent false
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance record showing absent false

Title: Mark attendance with null employeeId
Description: Verify response when employeeId is null in request body
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing absent true and employeeId null
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'

Title: Mark attendance with null absent
Description: Verify response when absent is null in request body
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId and absent null
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'

Title: Mark attendance with null request body
Description: Verify response when request body is null
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null body
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'

Title: Mark attendance with date provided
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId, absent and date provided
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId, absent and date
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance record with given date
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance record showing date 2024-06-01
